notes.title: “Whispers Left at Night” 7/31 Game Update Announcement
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45351791/24b78d3b5f07606249f374c3a095e6cb459872a8.jpg"]

1. Fixed a rare crash issue that could occur during gameplay.
2. Resolved a visual glitch where ghosting would appear on the message window when holding down the fast-forward key.
3. Fixed the language display for the text speed option in the settings menu — it will now change based on the selected language.
3. Added new names to the credits list.



【7/31 Second Update】

5. Fixed an issue where the word “True” would appear when clicking the left mouse button while adjusting volume.

notes.title: “Whispers Left at Night” 6/26 Game Update Announcement
notes.notes:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45316834/b23d1f1c40e4cbacd0824aa01cb36f5bc68bd72f.jpg

Hello everyone~
This is the first major update since the game was released earlier this January.

Here’s what’s included in this update:

 1. Added a "Quit Game" button
 2. Increased the initial startup resolution from 960x540 to 1280x720
 3. Achievement titles now change based on the selected language
 4. When holding down the Z key during dialogue, both the text and the bubble box now appear faster
 5. The game now supports Xbox, DUALSHOCK, and DualSense controllers


And most importantly:

 6. English translation has been added


Due to budget constraints, the English version was translated using ChatGPT.
If you encounter any major translation issues while playing, feel free to report them in the discussion board—thank you for your support!

notes.title: [RMAsia] Demo Version of "The Hearts of Immortality," a Tribute to Classic RPGs, Has Been Released
notes.notes:
[code]
Follow RMAsia Connoisseurs
[/code]

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41570851/5b3b6386668809b4a9f26ac8e8773717ad8e14d6.jpg
After two years of dedicated work, as a tribute to classic long-form fantasy RPGs, The Hearts of Immortality is finally ready for Early Access!

This game blends both narrative and combat elements, and you'll find plenty of the creator's hardcore nerd style throughout, including a wide variety of selectable classes and the player-driven dialogue choices.
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41570851/ccc79d063fc700d41ac5de90cf2513e376d6ee78.png

You can check out the DEMO version here, which includes the prologue and Act 1, "The Butcher of Laughmouth":
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3433660/Demo/
Download and try it out if you're interested – give it a go!
